about: Get the birth certificate of a child born in the UAE.
note: Requirements read from the official EHS service page on the checked date. EHS fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Birth certificate issue. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Applicant must be a parent or hold a special power of attorney
documents: Valid Emirates ID of the parents
timing: Immediate for a digitally attested certificate
